Screams mid-first-drop as a coaster-car of five minifigs plunges the steep trans-railed track, all arms thrown wide with open-mouth-scream prints, the lift-hill receding behind, a sixth rider death-gripping the lap-bar, the crowd below mid-recoil.

Tosses a ring mid-arc at a midway peg-board, a kid minifig arm fully extended, a brick ring frozen mid-flight toward the bottle-neck, a vendor minifig mid-gesture behind the counter, a parent clutching a prize-plush already won.

Splashes down mid-flume as a log-car of four minifigs hammers the trans-blue plate pool, a wall of white 1×1 round-plate spray erupting upward, riders bracing arms-up, a family on the bridge above mid-recoil from incoming droplets.

Collides mid-bumper-crash as two brick bumper-cars slam together, both driver minifigs jolted hard sideways with surprised-face prints, trans-yellow round-plates scattering as spark-suggestion, a third car nosing in from behind with a laughing-print kid at the wheel.

Wins a prize mid-celebration as a kid minifig thrusts a just-won plush-build overhead at a knockdown-game stall, the vendor mid-clap, three milk-bottle-builds tumbled across the counter from the winning throw, a sibling bouncing on tiptoe beside them.

Spins mid-carousel as four minifigs ride brick horses frozen at staggered up-down pole positions, one arm-up waving, a parent reaching across the safety-rail toward a small child rider, the canopy ring-lights bright above the frozen spin.

Grips the swing-ride chains mid-flight as eight seat-built minifigs fling outward at full extension, hair-pieces and scarves locked back in static brick-drag, the central hub angled below, a ground-crew minifig shielding their face from the blur of passing feet.

Reaches the ferris-wheel peak as a couple in a gondola-cabin lean forward with C-hands pointing out at the park spread below, the wheel-rim stud-lights ringing them, a family in the neighboring cabin mid-wave across the gap.

Hands over cotton-candy mid-transaction at a brick candy-cart, the vendor minifig extending a pink cotton-candy-build, a kid minifig reaching up with both C-hands, a balloon-bunch bobbing beside the cart-handle, a parent passing a coin-tile across the counter.

Aims mid-shooting-gallery as a minifig sights a brick pop-gun at a row of moving target-builds, one target mid-tip frozen at forty-five degrees, a sibling bouncing beside them on tiptoe, a prize-wall of plush-builds looming behind the counter.

Waves mid-parade as costumed minifigs atop a brick float fling streamer-elements into the crowd, kids along the curb thrusting arms up to catch, a balloon-vendor threading between spectators, a toddler minifig on a parent's shoulders mid-grab for a passing streamer.

Pours into the haunted-house entrance as a clutch of five minifigs crowd the creaky doorway, one mid-flinch-back from a spring-loaded skeleton-build popping up, trans-green glow spilling out across their surprised-face prints, a brave kid yanking a friend forward by the arm.

Launches mid-loop-scream as a coaster-car inverts through a trans-railed loop, three riders hanging at the apex with arms fully extended downward by inertia, open-mouth-scream prints locked on, loose coins suggested by flat-gold round-plates frozen mid-fall from pockets.

Reaches mid-ferris-peak as two kids in a gondola press C-hands against the cabin-rail, pointing down at tiny minifig crowds below, the neighboring cabin occupied by a grandparent minifig mid-wave across the arc, the sun-tile bright at the wheel's crown.

Grabs a balloon mid-reach as a kid minifig stretches both C-hands toward an escaping trans-red balloon-build drifting upward, a vendor lunging across the cart to re-catch the string-element, a parent mid-grab at the kid's waist to prevent a tumble.

Tosses a beanbag mid-carnival-throw at a stack of brick cans, the stack mid-topple with two cans already airborne, a kid minifig arm fully forward at release, a vendor mid-duck behind the counter, a crowd of three minifigs behind the throw-line mid-cheer.

Splashes mid-water-balloon-toss as a balloon-element bursts between two kid minifigs, both jolted back with drenched-face prints, trans-blue round-plates arcing outward as water-suggestion, a third kid minifig behind them mid-scramble away from the spray zone.

Collides mid-bumper-boat as two brick water-craft clip hulls on the trans-blue tile pond, both pilot minifigs tilted inward with open-mouth-laugh prints, a third boat's kid-driver spinning the wheel-brick hard to avoid the pileup, spray-plates scattering between hulls.

Hands off a corn-dog mid-vendor-transaction at a brick food-cart, the vendor minifig extending the yellow-built treat, a hungry kid minifig grabbing with one C-hand while a parent counts coin-tiles on the counter, a line of three more minifigs forming behind.

Wins mid-ring-toss as a teen minifig's brick ring lands perfectly over the bottle-neck peg, both arms shooting skyward with a victory-print expression, a vendor mid-reach for the grand-prize plush-build on the top shelf, a younger sibling tugging the winner's sleeve in excitement.

Spins mid-teacup-ride as three family minifigs crank the center-wheel disc of their brick teacup, frozen mid-rotation at a steep lean, open-mouth-laugh prints locked on, the surrounding ring of other spinning cups each holding minifigs at different tilt angles.

Catches a parade throw mid-air as a kid minifig leaps from the curb with both C-hands closing around a thrown candy-brick, a float-rider mid-release above, a parent minifig mid-grab at the kid's waist, a balloon bobbing in the crowd behind.

Drops mid-free-fall tower as a ride-car of four minifigs plunges the tall brick column, all arms thrown straight up with open-mouth-scream prints, the platform rushing below, a ground-level crowd of six minifigs mid-flinch upward in sympathy-reaction.

Pours out of a roller-coaster unload platform as six minifigs stream off a just-stopped coaster-car, one still shaking with a laugh-print, two high-fiving with C-hands locked mid-slap, a ride-operator minifig unlatching the next car's lap-bars, the queue behind surging forward.

Aims mid-dart-throw at a balloon-board, a teen minifig arm cocked back with a brick dart, a balloon-build mid-pop frozen at the moment of burst, the vendor mid-raise-arms in surprised-print reaction, a younger sibling covering their open-mouth-scream print in delight.
